chain: Chain A - About/Version/License Runtime State (Product Runtime Identity)
realBehaviorProven: buildRuntimeState() loads and validates the real product manifest (Batch 3 Versioning), resolves real trial/license state (Batch 4 Entitlements + Signed Licenses), and resolves enabled/read-only/disabled capabilities via Batch 5's real Capability Registry snapshot.

Capabilities enabled by the registry but blocked from writing (canExport=false) are reclassified read-only rather than fully enabled or silently hidden -- proven for an expired trial where export-project stays visible but write-blocked while open-project (canOpenProjects always true) remains fully enabled.
License expiry is reported from the real signed receipt payload when the state is LICENSED; a perpetual license reports null, never a fabricated date.
trialDaysRemaining is derived from Entitlements' injected-clock daysRemaining, never a static constant.
Rejections proven: malformed manifest, unsupported semantic version (major 0), wrong-product manifest/registry mismatch, unknown capability lookup, and a corrupted runtime-state or preferences file.
CLOSE/REOPEN: the full structured snapshot round-trips exactly via Batch 1's real AtomicSave.
Local preferences (locale/theme) persist transactionally and are entitlement-inert.
DETERMINISM: two builds from identical inputs and an identical injected clock are byte-identical.
